ValidationRule.description: 仕様: Core 第11.4.2節。入出金のFrom。
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(TargetObject__c, "InvoicePayment__c"), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(SourceObject__c, "Invoice__c"), ISPICKVAL(SourceObject__c, "BillingAccount__c"), ISPICKVAL(SourceObject__c, "ContractHistory__c"), ISPICKVAL(SourceObject__c, "Opportunity"), ISPICKVAL(SourceObject__c, "Account") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 入出金のFromは請求書、請求アカウント、契約履歴、商談、取引先です。
